newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIAN LEU 3,616 TO DOLLAR FOR DEC 11 - BNR.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIAN LEU 3,616 TO DOLLAR FOR DEC 11 - BNR.

text.p: Romania's National Bank (BNR) announced the leu's reference rate at 3,616 to the dollar for December 11.
This reference rate was set on Monday as a weighted average based on daily reports of foreign exchange operators. It is a guidance rate used for statistical accounting purposes.
The leu's reference rate set on Friday for December 10 is 3,618 to the dollar. It was 3,615 on Monday. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
